investigation: PSI-22, ACME E-FIELD Flames: coflow and gas-jet diffusion flames under a burner-to-mesh electric field
description: Second law of PROTOCOL 13.4 (docs/wsp/research/phys_efield2.md): the declaration of efield with has_coflow appended (index 7).

features.name: carbon_flow
features.description: fuel carbon atoms per second (case input carbon_flow_atoms_s)

features.name: x_fuel
features.description: fuel mole fraction of the fuel stream

features.name: voltage
features.description: magnitude of the level's v_cmd; for the targets without a level, the highest magnitude of the sweep

features.name: sweep_v_max
features.description: largest magnitude of v_cmd over the programme

targets.name: ion_current
targets.description: flame current at a planned voltage level, positive in the direction the field drives it, given that the flame still burns (lane-local)

targets.name: flame_end
targets.description: the flame goes out under the field, seconds since the field is switched on; no scheduled stop declared

targets.name: peak_voltage
targets.description: voltage at which the largest current is reached (lane-local)
